comparisons.peer_topic: Unaudited Pro Forma Financial Information for VMware Acquisition
comparisons.peer_summary: The unaudited pro forma financial information presents the combined results of operations as if VMware had been acquired as of the beginning of fiscal year 2023, including adjustments for intangible asset amortization, stock-based compensation, interest expense, and depreciation.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom disclose supplemental unaudited pro forma financial results to illustrate the impact of major acquisitions as if they had occurred at the beginning of a prior fiscal period. AMD presents pro forma results for the acquisitions of Xilinx and Pensando as if consummated at the beginning of fiscal 2022, whereas Broadcom presents combined results for the VMware acquisition as if acquired at the beginning of fiscal 2023. Both disclosures serve the same purpose of providing historical context for their respective transaction impacts.
